description: Department: Product & Implementation Experience: 2–5 years (flexible for candidates with relevant skills) About the Role We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Business Analyst to support the successful adoption and ongoing use of our enterprise software platform. This role will primarily focus on product training, user onboarding, functional support, and issue resolution following the software launch. The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding complex software workflows, simplifying them for different audiences, and helping users confidently navigate the platform. The individual will work closely with the Product, Implementation, Development, and Business teams to ensure a seamless transition from implementation to ongoing product usage. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Training & User Enablement Develop a comprehensive understanding of the software's modules, features, workflows, and business processes. Conduct virtual and in-person product training sessions for internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders. Simplify complex product functionality and business workflows into easy-to understand training content. Create and maintain user guides, training presentations, FAQs, walkthroughs, and other learning resources. Deliver role-based training tailored to different user groups and their responsibilities within the software. Conduct refresher sessions and communicate new features, enhancements, and workflow changes to existing users. Collect training feedback and continuously improve training effectiveness. 2. Post-Launch Functional Support Serve as a primary point of contact for functional queries and user assistance following software implementation. Assist users in navigating the platform, understanding workflows, and resolving day to-day functional challenges. Investigate reported issues, reproduce errors, and distinguish between user errors, configuration issues, and potential product defects. Document support tickets with clear descriptions, reproduction steps, screenshots, and business impact. Coordinate with Product and Development teams to escalate technical issues and track them through resolution. Maintain clear communication with users regarding issue status, workarounds, and resolutions. Identify recurring support issues and recommend improvements to training materials, documentation, or product functionality. 3. Product Knowledge & Business Analysis Develop a strong understanding of business workflows and how they are supported within the software. Work with the Product and Implementation teams to understand new functionality, enhancements, and configuration changes. Translate user feedback and operational challenges into clearly documented business requirements or improvement recommendations. Support functional testing and validation of product enhancements before they are released to users. Assist in identifying gaps between expected and actual system behavior. Maintain updated functional documentation as the software continues to evolve. 4. User Adoption & Continuous Improvement Support post-launch stabilization and help users transition smoothly to the software. Monitor user feedback, support trends, and common areas of confusion to identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with stakeholders to improve product usability and overall user experience. Track training effectiveness, support resolution trends, and user satisfaction. Contribute to building a scalable knowledge base and structured support process. Required Skills & Qualifications 2–5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Application Support, Product Training, Functional Consulting, or a related role. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical or functional concepts to non-technical audiences. Experience delivering software training, product demonstrations, or end-user onboarding sessions. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate them into clear documentation and training content. Familiarity with ticket management, issue tracking, and documentation tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, or Confluence. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple user requests. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-centric approach. Willingness to independently learn new product functionality and adapt to evolving business requirements. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms or workflow-driven business applications. Experience supporting enterprise software implementations and post-go-live stabilization. Familiarity with UAT, functional testing, defect tracking, and release management. Experience creating training videos, knowledge-base articles, and structured learning materials. Exposure to change management, user adoption, and continuous process improvement. Experience supporting software used in industries such as insurance, financial services, or enterprise operations would be an advantage. What Success Looks Like Users are confident in navigating the software and performing their day-to-day activities. Training sessions are structured, engaging, and effective for different user groups. Functional queries and support requests are addressed accurately and within agreed timelines. Recurring issues are identified, documented, and reduced through proactive training or product improvements. Product documentation and knowledge resources remain accurate and up to date. Software adoption and user satisfaction improve following implementation. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is analytical like a Business Analyst, engaging like a Product Trainer, and solution-oriented like a Functional Support Consultant.
